notes.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed | OUT NOW!
notes.content:
📣 Continue the story of blockbuster-hit Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem in a brand new TMNT adventure 🐢 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed is officially unleashed today on PC, Xbox, Playstation and Nintendo Switch! 🎮🍕

Embark on an immersive journey through the streets and sewers of New York as an all-new wave of mutants rears from the depths. Take the reins as Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello and Michelangelo in thrilling solo or 2-player co-op action to restore peace to NYC! 💥

Don’t miss out on the action-packed mayhem with your favorite heroes! 🐢
